run_train_ip_adapter: run the IP-Adapter training script with pretrained model, data JSON, and image encoder paths
create_dataset_mydataset: create a MyDataset instance from a JSON file with tokenizer, resolution, and image root path
build_ip_adapter_module: build an IPAdapter module with UNet, image projection model, adapter modules, and optional checkpoint path
test_collate_fn: test the collate_fn function that batches images, text input IDs, clip images, and drop flags
parse_args_cli: parse CLI arguments for IP-Adapter training including model paths, data, resolution, learning rate, and batch size
